Every app and website starts as an idea. What matters is building them. Replit makes that the fun part. It’s an AI app builder and website builder for people who like turning “what ifs?” into real projects. Just describe what you want, and Replit builds it — mobile apps, websites, slides, videos, data dashboards, and more.

Ready to become a creator? Download Replit and start creating apps, websites, and anything else you imagine in minutes.

No coding. No tools to learn. Just describe what you need in plain language, and Replit handles the building, testing, debugging, and hosting — all in one place. It's like having an entire team of engineers and designers on demand, available through a simple chat.

Top things you can do with this website builder and app platform

SHIP ANYTHING
One website builder and app platform for everything you want to make:
- Mobile and web apps — shareable and live in minutes
- Websites and prototypes
- Slide decks and presentations
- Videos and animations
- Data apps and dashboards

DESIGN FREELY
Design directly on a live canvas. Use multi-select, hover state editing, responsive overrides, and real-time preview — and see every change applied to your actual project instantly. No handoff. No gap between what you picture and what ships. Only an AI app builder works this fast.

BUILD TOGETHER
Every request becomes a structured task your team can track. Add tasks anytime, see progress in real-time, and stay focused on what matters — while Replit handles the maintenance, updates, and complexity in the background.

MOVE FASTER
Multiple AI agents work across your project simultaneously — building infrastructure, integrating services, and refining features at once. What used to take cycles now happens in parallel.

WEB TO MOBILE IN ONE STEP
Already built something on web? Convert it to a mobile app without starting over.

EVERYTHING BUILT IN — ZERO SETUP
Authentication, database, hosting, and monitoring are all included from day one. No configuration, no infrastructure decisions. Build fully scalable apps securely from the start.

100+ INTEGRATIONS, NO API KEYS NEEDED
Connect to OpenAI, Stripe, Google Workspace, enterprise data warehouses, and more. Turn your project into a fully connected system in minutes, not days.

SECURE BY DEFAULT
Pre-deployment security screening, secure built-in services, and enterprise-grade controls — including SSO/SAML and SOC2 — so what you build stays protected.

WHO USES REPLIT:
- Founders and entrepreneurs building their first product or MVP
- Designers who want to ship without depending on a developer
- Product managers building internal tools and prototypes
- Marketers who need campaign tools and dashboards
- Students creating real projects for their portfolio
- Anyone looking for the fastest app builder to go from idea to launch

Got an idea? Let’s see what it can become. Creativity runs on Replit. The AI app builder that’s trusted by 50 million creators and builders worldwide.

The website builder and app creator for everyone. Get started for free — download and build something today.
